title: FIFO Frontier
summary: Process discovered or waiting items in the same order they entered the frontier so earlier arrivals or shallower layers are handled first.
recognition_signals: oldest waiting work must be handled first
discovery should proceed layer by layer
new items join the back while processing happens at the front
core_rules: Remove from the front and add new frontier items at the back.
Mark discovery at enqueue time when duplicate enqueues would be harmful.
structural_steps: append newly discovered or newly arriving items
repeat until the frontier is empty

common_confusions.distinction: A queue processes oldest-first; a stack processes newest-first.
A queue chooses by arrival/discovery order. A heap chooses by priority value.
